correctness.rationale: PASS. The full normalized fixed-center coefficient space has 2^18 binary quintic forms. A quadratic tangent cone and cubic transverse term classify ordinary split/nonsplit nodes and cusps; rejecting Jacobian-zero points at every closed point degree 1 through 5 and every factor of degrees 1 or 2 certifies the one ordinary singularity and geometric integrality, using genus defect and degree-five conjugate-line reasoning. For each of the three P^1(F2) lines through the singular center, the order-two exceptional factor leaves a binary cubic whose geometric factorization supplies five fibre types. A fresh independently written exact finite-field census—not either submitted checker—enumerated all 2^18 masks, field orbits (closed-point counts 6,7,22,63,210), degree-1/2 factor products and the three cubic fibres. It recovered 67,608 valid fixed-center forms, split/nonsplit/cusp totals 36,840/12,384/18,384, 75 nonempty (singularity,triple) cells, 34 realized unordered triples, and only missing (LLL,LLL,LLL). A separate fresh check reconstructed all 34 supplied witness masks and their fibre factorizations. These finite computations are exhaustive of the stated finite equation space, not a theorem about all characteristics or genera.
residual_risks: Counts are of embedded fixed-center equations, not abstract isomorphism classes.
Exhaustiveness depends on finite-field irreducible-polynomial implementation and genus-defect bound, independently reimplemented.
